items.title: Eat Dog Food
items.detail: Take Canned Dog Food from the Weenie Wagon at your C.A.M.P. or another player's camp and eat it.

items.title: Build a Trap in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Open build menu, go to Defense, and place any trap. Punji Board costs only 4 steel and 8 wood.

items.title: Collect a Fuel Tank or Gas Canister
items.detail: Find at industrial and roadside locations like Toxic Larry's Meat 'n Go, Sons of Dane Compound, or Grafton Steel.

items.title: Collect a Teddy Bear
items.detail: Northeast of Knife Edge in a half-destroyed shack; use a grenade to knock bears down from the ledge.

items.title: Cripple a Mirelurk's Limb
items.detail: Fast travel to Spruce Knob Lake and cripple a Mirelurk's limb with a rifle; V.A.T.S. makes it easier.

items.title: Cripple enemy limbs
items.detail: Go to Morgantown Airport and cripple Scorched limbs with a rifle; each crippled limb counts separately.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Circuitry
items.detail: Scrap Sensor Modules, Enhanced Targeting Cards, Telephones, or Military-grade Circuit Boards at any workbench.

items.title: Build a Turret or Trap in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Open C.A.M.P. build menu and place any turret or trap under Defense. Punji Board costs 4 steel and 8 wood.

items.title: Harvest a Prickeye
items.detail: Fast travel to Tycoon Lake in Burning Springs region and harvest orange bulbs. Can also plant as Slipper Cactus in C.A.M.P.

items.title: Kill Insects
items.detail: Visit Giant Teapot and start Strange Brew Daily Quest with Sweetwater, or go to Tanagra Town for up to ten Cave Crickets.

items.title: Kill The Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher
items.detail: Start a Head Hunt at Highway Town bounty board for 5,000 caps; Slasher appears as final opponent in this four-star event.

items.title: Kill a Cultist
items.detail: Fast travel to Point Pleasant for up to 34 Cultists. Use V.A.T.S. targeting the head as weak spot.

items.title: Repair Armor, Weapons, or Power Armor
items.detail: Grab a Protest Sign at Grafton, degrade it on an enemy, then repair at workbench with one Wood.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Acid
items.detail: Craft Bulk Acid at Tinker's Workbench in C.A.M.P. or Whitespring Resort, then scrap it.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Crystal
items.detail: Scrap crystal liquor decanters or floater freezer pus sacs at any workbench. Clancy Manor has decanters on tables.

items.title: Travel on foot (KM)
items.detail: Sprint under encumbered limit on open ground avoiding enemies. Route from Vault-Tec Agricultural Research Center north to Morgantown works well.

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge!
items.detail: Earn Gold Star on three separate days this week by completing any six daily challenges per day.

events.name: Gold Rush and Double Mutations
events.description: Increased caps rewards and double mutation spawns in public events.

events.name: Mutated Public Events
events.description: All public events feature mutated variants with special rewards from Mutated Packages.

events.name: Double XP Weekend
events.description: Double experience rewards for all activities and faster character leveling.

events.name: World Pets Update (Patch 72)
events.description: Major update introducing world pets and beginning Season 27.

events.name: Treasure Hunter and Double Mutations
events.description: Treasure Hunter event with special loot and double mutation spawns in events.

events.name: Holiday Scorched
events.description: Limited-time event featuring holiday-themed Scorched enemies with special rewards.
